I will grow beans on this small piece because they feed my family and put nitrogen back into the soil. I am not buying chemical fertilizer for beans — any cash I have must go to the maize, and beans do not need it anyway. I will spread what manure I can collect from our animals, and I will plant the same local seed I kept from last year. My children and I will do all the work ourselves; the plot is too small to waste money hiring anyone.
